author: Kushal
problem: A warehouse gives each of its count crates a different ID written in binary, with every ID using the same number of bits. Return the fewest bits needed (at least 1).
bug_description: Uses count.bit_length() instead of (count - 1).bit_length(), so when count is a power of two (IDs 0 to count - 1) it asks for one bit more than needed.

comments.accurate: Returns the fewest bits that give every crate its own binary ID
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the number of bits needed to write the crate count itself in binary
comments.wrong_location: Bit length checked; a single crate might only need 0 bits rather than 1
